WITH web_v1 as ( select ws_item_sk item_sk, d_date, sum(sum(ws_sales_price)) over (partition by ws_item_sk order by d_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cume_sales from web_sales ,date_dim where ws_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1212 and 1212+11 and ws_item_sk is not NULL group by ws_item_sk, d_date), store_v1 as ( select ss_item_sk item_sk, d_date, sum(sum(ss_sales_price)) over (partition by ss_item_sk order by d_date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cume_sales from store_sales ,date_dim where ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1212 and 1212+11 and ss_item_sk is not NULL group by ss_item_sk, d_date), dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        s.item_sk,
        d.d_date,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'store') AS store_cnt,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'web') AS web_cnt,
        SUM(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'store') AS store_daily,
        SUM(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.channel = 'web') AS web_daily
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
            ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
            ss_sales_price AS amount,
            'store'::text AS channel
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
            ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
            ws_sales_price AS amount,
            'web'::text AS channel
        FROM web_sales
        WHERE ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    ) s
    JOIN dates d ON d.d_date_sk = s.date_sk
    GROUP BY s.item_sk, d.d_date
)
SELECT
    item_sk,
    d_date,
    CASE WHEN web_cnt > 0 THEN web_cume END AS web_sales,
    CASE WHEN store_cnt > 0 THEN store_cume END AS store_sales,
    web_cume AS web_cumulative,
    store_cume AS store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT
        item_sk,
        d_date,
        web_cnt,
        store_cnt,
        SUM(web_daily) OVER (
            PARTITION BY item_sk
            ORDER BY d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS web_cume,
        SUM(store_daily) OVER (
            PARTITION BY item_sk
            ORDER BY d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS store_cume
    FROM daily
) z
WHERE web_cume > store_cume
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
